name: Asayake Lodge
description: Asayake Lodge is a calm block theme for a small guest house that hosts families and carers of hospital patients. The home page opens on a dusk-rose field around an inset, rounded film-grain photograph with a docked four-cell bar and one slow shaft of dawn light, then puts the headline below the photo with a day-line and three cards hung from its ticks. It continues with a bordered notes card, a sticky photo beside five hour rows, three room cards, a parallax night corridor, who the stay is for, a full-width rate list, a tilted key-card band and house letters. Fraunces and Karla, muted film-grain photography, quiet scroll effects.
